19/10/16
Shanghai Municipal Council.
October 19th 1916
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Sir,
About twenty members of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce
met at the Guild on the 18th inst to discuss the question
of repatriation funds. There were none of the Rebels present.
It was decided to send a telegram to the Central Government
asking for more funds. Yu Ya Ching also proposed
that a sum of money for repatriation purposes be raised
among the local merchants and this was agreed to.
A meeting of the rebels who are natives of Hupeh was
held at No.37 Woo Shing Li 吴兴里 Rue Marcel Tillot
on the 18th inst. There was an attendance of about 200
persons. The meeting was somewhat noisy owing to the
appearance on the scene of one Woo Au 吴Au who lives at
255 Avenue Joffre. He was accused of being a spy during
the 2nd revolution and forcibly expelled from the meeting.
About 200 rebels who are natives of Anhui also held
a meeting at No.4 Ming Teh Li 明德里 Rue Engine Band
on the 18th inst. It was decided to ask the Chamber of
Commerce to augment the repatriation funds, to write to
General Yang on the same subject, to ignore all notices
issued by the Repatriation Board and to refuse to participate
in the forthcoming distribution of repatriation funds. The
meeting was quite quiet and orderly.
A meeting of rebels who are natives of Kiangsu will
be held to-day at 10 a.m. at 565 Siau Tuh Li 修德里
when the repatriation scheme will be discussed.
The workmen at the Arsenal will be granted a holiday
on the 20th inst that being the birthday of President Li.
The transfer of troops from Loongwha to Sungkiang
and vice versa took place on the 18th.

Your Obedient Servant,
（签名）
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

上海工部局。
1916年10月19日
（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科）

先生：
本月18日，约二十名华商总会成员在会馆集会，讨论遣返经费问题。叛乱分子无人出席。会议决定向中央政府发送电报，请求增加经费。虞洽卿还提议在当地商人中筹集一笔用于遣返的款项，该提议获得通过。
本月18日，籍贯为湖北的叛乱分子在马思南路（Rue Marcel Tillot）吴兴里37号举行会议。出席人数约200人。由于居住在霞飞路255号的吴Au（音译）出现在现场，会议场面有些嘈杂。他被指控在二次革命期间充当间谍，并被强行逐出会场。
本月18日，约200名籍贯为安徽的叛乱分子也在爱多亚路（Rue Engine Band）明德里4号举行了会议。会议决定请求商会增加遣返经费，就同一事项致函杨将军，无视遣返局发布的所有通告，并拒绝参与即将进行的遣返经费分发。会议过程十分安静有序。
籍贯为江苏的叛乱分子将于今日上午10时在修德里565号举行会议，届时将讨论遣返方案。
兵工厂工人将于本月20日放假，因该日为黎总统诞辰。
部队于18日在龙华与松江之间进行了互换调动。

您顺从的仆人，
（签名）
总探长。

警务处总监。
